name: muslim-expert
description: Read the Quran with the app's translations, find duas, learn the 99 names of Allah and check prayer times, then continue in the Muslim Expert app.

interface.longDescription: Read the Quran in Arabic with the translations of the Muslim Expert app, 60 translations in 42 languages with transliteration. Find duas for every moment of the day with their Arabic text, translation and hadith reference, learn the 99 names of Allah, and get prayer times for about 70,000 cities, calculated with the method the app uses for each country or the method you choose. Answers quote the exact Arabic text and name each translation, so quotations stay separate from explanations. After an answer, an optional card opens the same verse, dua, names or prayer times in Muslim Expert, or its download page, to continue with recitations, adhan reminders and the Qibla. No account is needed. The plugin only reads published content: it cannot save notes or conversations, change app settings or import ChatGPT studies into the app.
defaultPrompt: Explique-moi Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) avec une traduction française.
What time is Maghrib in London today?
Which dua is said before travelling?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the Quran in Arabic with the app's 60 translations, duas with their references, the 99 names of Allah and prayer times for about 70,000 cities in the 16 app languages, plus an optional card to download Muslim Expert or open the same content in the app.

positive.prompt: Explique-moi Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) avec une traduction française.
positive.expected_behavior: Quote the exact Arabic text and the Hamidullah translation of 2:255, answer fully in French, distinguish the translation from the explanation and offer one Quran card for the same verse.

positive.prompt: Which dua is said before travelling?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the travel chapter of the app's duas, give the Arabic text, transliteration, translation and hadith reference without changing them, and offer the matching dua card.

positive.prompt: What time is Maghrib in London today?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve London in the United Kingdom, give today's Maghrib time with the calculation method that was applied, mention that local mosques can differ, and offer the prayer times card.

positive.description: Meaning of a name of Allah
positive.prompt: What does the name Al-Wadud mean?
positive.expected_behavior: Use name 47 of the app's list with its Arabic, transliteration and meaning, explain it without presenting personal opinion as the source, and offer a card for that name.

positive.description: Short surah with an English translation
positive.prompt: Help me understand Surah Al-Ikhlas with an English translation.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve 112:1-4 in Arabic with an English translation from the app, name the translation, explain the surah and offer the matching Quran card.

negative.prompt: Save this conversation in my Muslim Expert notes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only reads published content and cannot save notes or conversations in the app; do not claim that anything was saved.

negative.prompt: Quote Surah Al-Fatiha in the Muhammad Asad translation using Muslim Expert.
negative.expected_behavior: Call list_quran_translations, explain that this translation is not available and offer one of the listed English translations; never attribute a quotation to Muhammad Asad.

negative.prompt: Give me today's Fajr time in Paris but do not suggest installing any app.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer with the calculated Fajr time and method, and omit show_study_card and any download promotion.
